key_decisions.reason: Avoid manual CREATE TABLE scripts and safely evolve the schema without losing production data.

key_decisions.decision: Use Dataclasses for Hotspot/User Manager sessions
key_decisions.reason: Eliminate Primitive Obsession, prevent typos in dict keys, and ensure type safety.
Remove Magic Strings from handlers, simplify translation, and standardize the UX.

key_decisions.decision: Pagination for long lists (Server-side and In-memory)
key_decisions.reason: Telegram limits message size and callback data. Paginating results prevents memory bloat and API crashes.

key_decisions.decision: Move general Telegram helpers to utils/tg_helpers.py
key_decisions.reason: Prevent circular imports between utils/error_response.py and bot/handlers/.

key_decisions.decision: Centralized handler/callback registration with source-of-truth tokens
key_decisions.reason: All callback_data constants and patterns live in bot/handlers/callback_constants.py and are referenced by name (PATTERNS) in bot/registrations.py to prevent frozen-button regressions.

key_decisions.decision: ConversationHandler entry points only (no standalone duplicates)
key_decisions.reason: Multi-step flows (hotspot_add/edit/delete/search/cards, usage_start, batches_search, logs_filter_text) register only as CH entry_point+fallback; standalone registration swallowed flow starts and broke e2e_smoke step 11b.

The previous kb/ was generated over the active venv (710/974 modules from scripts/Activate.ps1) and tests. scripts/generate_kb.py now excludes venv/tests/build artifacts; runtime surface = 133 modules, 1098 entities.

testing_status: All 2961 tests passing. Circular imports and Pyright type issues resolved.
